title: Strict henselization after quotient given structures
statement: Let A,B be commutative local rings in one universe, K and L separable closures of their residue fields with compatible residue-field and base algebra structures. Let C be an A-algebra satisfying IsStrictHenselization A K C [def-sc-ring-strict-henselization]. Let pi:A\to B be surjective with kernel I contained in the maximal ideal of A. There exists a B-algebra structure on the explicit quotient C/IC such that IsStrictHenselization B L (C/IC). The action is supplied by the quotient construction, not quantified arbitrarily.

proof.text: Use the final pointed-etale base-change functor and its natural isomorphism of underlying diagrams.

Apply H to the universal cocone for C. H is a composite of equivalences and a left adjoint pushout functor, so preserves colimits. Transport the cocone along the diagram comparison and extend along the final functor using Functor.Final.isColimitExtendCoconeEquiv.

Put J = I.map(algebraMap A C) and q = Ideal.Quotient.mk J. The equality ker(pi) = I and Ideal.le_comap_map show that q composed with the A-action kills ker(pi). Descend this map along the surjection using RingHom.liftOfSurjective, and equip C/J with the resulting B-action. RingHom.liftOfSurjective_comp_apply proves the required compatibility equation. Apply the proved upstream quotientBaseChangeObjIso to identify the new vertex with C/J, then compose this with H of the original vertex isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Tag 05WS; original final-cocone argument, with explicit quotient-action descent and the adopted upstream quotientBaseChangeObjIso API

lean.statement:
theorem strictHenselization_surjective_quotient_core
    (A K C B L : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [Field K]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K] [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K]
    [Algebra A K] [IsScalarTower A (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K]
    [CommRing C] [Algebra A C] (hC : IsStrictHenselization A K C)
    [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [Field L]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) L]
    [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) L]
    [Algebra B L] [IsScalarTower B (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) L]
    (π : A →+* B) (hπ : Function.Surjective π)
    (I : Ideal A) (_hI : I ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) (hker : RingHom.ker π = I) :
    ∃ (_ : Algebra B (C ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A C))),
      IsStrictHenselization B L (C ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A C))

statement_change.old_statement: Given the compatible residue-field and quotient algebra structures, the quotient of a strict henselization is a strict henselization of the quotient ring.
statement_change.what: The original Lean signature quantified over an arbitrary B-action on C/IC, without compatibility with pi. For I=0 and identity pi, a nonsurjective field self-embedding as this action contradicts uniqueness of the pointed-etale colimit. The corrected signature constructs the action existentially, as the source and caller require.

old_proof.text: Construct the residue-field comparison, finality of base change on pointed etale algebras, and identify the resulting colimit.
